pkg.lyricsBlock:
[Intro]
(soft cinematic piano intro, quiet atmosphere)

[Verse 1]
At the end of a weary day
the dark begins to fall
a quiet light slips through the room
like a distant star

A trace of your passing touch
rests somewhere in the air
and in the silent space of night
my heart still hears it there

[Chorus]
Your memory still shines somewhere
beyond the reach of time
in a pause between the hours
I wander through the night

The more I try to let it fade
the clearer it becomes
your voice still breathing softly
inside the quiet room

[Verse 2]
Even the passing wind tonight
carries something warm
a shadow of your gentle smile
drifting through my thoughts

No matter how I close my eyes
the echo stays the same
a fragile piece of yesterday
whispering your name

[Piano Solo]
(expressive emotional piano solo, reflective and flowing)

[Bridge]
If you cannot return to me
meet me inside a dream
just a moment holding warmth
would be enough to breathe

This colorless and silent world
moves slowly without you
and every quiet step I take
still circles back to you

[Chorus]
Your memory still shines somewhere
beyond the reach of time
I follow through the quiet dark
where fading lights align

Even if I cannot hold
the shadow that you leave
I keep walking through the night
where you once stood with me

[Outro]
(soft emotional piano outro, fading gently)

If there is nowhere you remain
inside this empty sky
I walk through dreams and silent roads
still searching for your light
